source.title: Call for Applicants - WMT Leader (January 2021)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new **WCA Marketing Team (WMT) Leader**, as Somya Srivastava’s term has ended. We would like to thank Somya for all of the work she did leading the team. 

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 7 hours per week on average to work for the committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

* Strong leadership skills
* Marketing background
* Social Media knowledge
* Excellent communication skills

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until **February 14th, 2021, 23:59 UTC**. Interested candidates can send the application privately to Callum Goodyear ([cgoodyear@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:cgoodyear@worldcubeassociation.org)).
<!-- break -->
The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

* Brief personal introduction.
* Summary of activities done for the WCA.
* Ambitions as the WMT Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WMT can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2018.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2018.1%20-%20Marketing%20Team.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2020.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

Thank you for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: WCA 市场团队招募负责人（2021 年 1 月）
translation.content:
Somya Srivastava 的任期已满，WCA 将任命新的 **WCA 市场团队（WMT）负责人**。感谢 Somya 在带领团队期间所做的全部工作。

申请人应能完成 24 个月任期，并平均每周至少投入 7 小时处理团队事务。我们希望申请人具备：

* 出色的领导能力。
* 市场营销背景。
* 社交媒体知识。
* 出色的沟通能力。

申请从即日起开放，截止时间为 **2021 年 2 月 14 日 23:59 UTC**。有意者请私下将材料发送给 Callum Goodyear（[cgoodyear@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:cgoodyear@worldcubeassociation.org)）。
<!-- break -->
申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

* 简短的个人介绍。
* 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
* 担任 WCA 市场团队负责人的工作设想。

另请提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WMT 的权利与职责见 [WCA 议案 10.2018.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2018.1%20-%20Marketing%20Team.pdf)。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将通过投票选出新负责人，并按照 [WCA 议案 10.2020.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) 第 4 节，经高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后公布。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
